news.headline: LMSYS Org Launches SGLang Consortium with NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Google, Meta, Cloudflare, Modal and RadixArk to Advance Open-Source AI Inference
news.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 12, 2026--LMSYS Org, the nonprofit behind the open-source AI engine SGLang, today launched the SGLang Consortium with founding members NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Google, Meta, Cloudflare, Modal and RadixArk, who will work with SGLang’s maintainers to help shape the project’s roadmap and advance open-source AI inference.
